evidence: One person's own site: an index of their client case studies (templates/routes.json: 1 index + 10 case routes).

Calls to action are personal contact links (email, LinkedIn, book); no pricing, plans, sign-up, accounts, dashboards or integrations exist in the clone (src/pages/HomePage.jsx, src/pages/CasePage.jsx).
One case is password-gated client work (templates/routes.json access=password-gated).

rules: Generated pages describe a fictional studio or person; never the source owner, their clients, or their work.
Real client logos, the owner's likeness, case screenshots/videos and the 3D mascot are reference-only or blocked (assets/asset-roles.json, pinned in code).
Password-gated content is reference evidence only; a generated page never reproduces gated client material.
Exactly one accent token per case page (hero.case style.accent); everything else is fixed by section contracts.

generationRules.mode: PageSpec.mode is required; generated mode triggers GENERATED_MODE_* rules in schema/semantic_validate.py.

approval.note: Classification and binding were proposed by an automated build pass and have not been ratified by the human owner.
